style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, warm autumn colours, simple clean background, gentle camera movement, no text, no letters, no words on screen, no speech, only soft natural sound effects.

words.scene: A kind cartoon grandfather in a sunny apple orchard slowly bends forward at the waist, stooping low with one hand on his knee, and picks up a shiny red apple from the grass, then straightens up and smiles.
The camera slowly rises up the trunk of a huge old oak tree to its wide, heavy leafy branches spreading out like arms; a small bird flies in and lands in a nest on one of the big branches.
In a cool shady garden corner, a curled young fern frond slowly unrolls into a long feathery green leaf, among other lush feather-like fern leaves gently moving.
Close-up of soft bright green moss covering wet grey rocks beside a sparkling stream; a cartoon child's hand gently presses the spongy moss and water droplets glisten.
A cheerful cartoon traveler with a small backpack and walking stick strolls along a winding country road, passing one little village and heading toward another village on the next hill.
A tiny round brown wren bird with its short tail pointing straight up perches on a green hedge branch, opens its beak and sings sweetly, its little chest puffing in and out.
A smiling cartoon family walks out of a very large elegant mansion with a big beautiful garden, a fountain, tall gates and a shiny car, everything looking rich and luxurious.
A cartoon classroom of ten children votes: on the board are two pictures, a lion and a painting; eight children excitedly raise their hands for the lion while only two raise hands for the painting.
Two cartoon runners sprint side by side toward a finish ribbon and cross it at exactly the same moment, the ribbon snapping in the middle, slow motion, both throwing their arms up together.
A smiling famous cartoon author sits at a table signing books for a long line of excited fans, camera flashes popping and people clapping and cheering in admiration.
Time-lapse of an old wooden footbridge over a river as rain pours: the planks crack, sag, grow dark and mossy, and one board breaks and falls, the bridge getting worse and worse.
